effect_description_eng:
[On Play] By trashing 1 [Morphomon] or [Eosmon] in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
[All Turns] While you have [Eosmon], all of your opponent's Tamers [On Play] effects don't activate.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your [Eosmon] would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, by deleting 1 of your other [Eosmon], prevent it.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
